note.purpose: The single Goudy italic line under the hero actions, in text-soft, 48ch.

shadows.name: lamplight-underglow
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest: warm blush light on water beneath it.

shadows.name: lamplight-underglow-hover

shadows.name: hero-glow
shadows.purpose: Low blush light behind the hero actions, over night-900.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing for lifts, glows, the arrow and entrances.

motion.name: unveil
motion.value: 2.4s ease-out both; from brightness(0.4) saturate(0.7) scale(1.03)
motion.purpose: Hero key visual: the lamps come up on the palace.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero actions and note settle after the unveil.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: entrances only under no-preference; under reduce, transition and animation 0.01ms, 1 iteration
motion.purpose: Everything settles instantly for visitors who ask for less motion.

breakpoints.name: portrait
breakpoints.purpose: Loads the 2:1 mobile key visual, shown at 1.6:1, object-position 62% 50%, 4% side feather, width min(100%, (vh - reserve) x 1.6).

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Actions stack full-width up to 24rem and overlap the plate by 1.5rem; base text 1.125rem.

narrative.overview:
The page is the palace night of the supplied key visual, and nothing more: one screen of dark slate sky with the key visual centred in it, its edges dissolving into the night. Lettering is cream-gold Trajan capitals, the same voice as the title on the banner; the visitor is spoken to in Goudy italic, the storytelling voice. Colour beyond night and gold arrives only as light: the low lantern-blush glow behind the actions, the warm underglow beneath the primary button, the coral of a text selection.

The world is brief-pinned to the client's key visual ("use the same fonts same colors"), so the banner is the source of truth for hue, type and atmosphere. Density is minimal and ceremonial: one plate, two actions, one line. Ornament is restricted to the world's own materials: fine gold hairlines and a single stroked arrow.
keyCharacteristics: One night-slate ground filling exactly one screen; no light grounds, no further sections.
Cream-gold Trajan capitals for every label; Goudy italic for the one line that speaks to the visitor.
Lotus coral and blush appear only as light, never as fills of any size.
Gold hairlines draw the quiet button's border and the primary button's printed inner rule.
Motion is lamplight: the palace brightens, then the actions rise; nothing slides in from the side.

rules.name: The Lamplight Rule
rules.body: Lotus coral and blush are light sources. They fill a glow, a shadow or a selection; they never fill a section, a card or a button.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: The only surface is Palace Night, warmed by a low blush glow. Lake Night appears only under the quiet button. A second ground needs a reason in the key visual.

rules.name: The Licensed First Rule
rules.body: Every stack names the brand's licensed face first and its free stand-in second. Never ship a stack that skips to a system serif for display.

rules.name: The Italic Narrator Rule
rules.body: Goudy italic is the voice that speaks to the visitor. It is the only Goudy face shipped; roman reading text would need the roman face restored first.

rules.name: The No Bold Rule
rules.body: Trajan stays at weight 400 with tracking for emphasis; font-synthesis-weight is off.

rules.name: The One Screen Rule
rules.body: The page is one full-screen hero at every size. Nothing sits above or below it.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow under a lettered control is warm blush light, offset low and blurred. No black shadows ship.

dos: Do take every hue from the key visual; it is the authority for colour and type in this world.
Do set labels in the Trajan stack at weight 400 with 0.2em tracking, uppercase.
Do use Goudy italic in text-soft for the line that speaks to the visitor.
Do draw borders and rules as 1px gold hairlines.
Do keep lotus and blush as light: glows, underglow, selection.
Do keep one primary (cream-gold) action, paired with at most one quiet button.
Do size the plate to the screen so the actions and note stay on the first screen.
Do gate entrance motion behind prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add sections below the hero; the page is one full-screen hero (user direction, 22 October 2026).
Don't add a header, footer or top bar (user direction, 22 October 2026).
Don't list products or prices on the page (user direction).
Don't serve phones the desktop plate in portrait; they load the dedicated mobile key visual (user direction).
Don't fill a section, card or button with lotus coral or blush.
Don't bold Trajan or set the display stack without its licensed faces first.
Don't frame or round the key visual; it dissolves into the night through masks.
Don't add ornament outside the world's own set: gold hairlines and the stroked arrow.
